{{Quote|What's more, the blockade has been strengthened around the planet to stop any further incursions by Separatist forces.|[[Unidentified Bandomeer commander|A commander]], to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Dead Shadows">{{TCWComicCite|6.39|Dead Shadows}}</ref>}}
The '''Bandomeer system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Meerian sector/Legends|Meerian sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained three [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]].<ref name="GORW" />
